mentions.name: Motion Party
mentions.description: A collection of party games controlled by waving in front of your camera, similar to the PlayStation EyeToy, supporting 1-4 players. The developer plans to tweak the camera detection algorithm so buttons work better and to add more games.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://motionparty.net/ - A collection of games you control by waving in front of your camera, similar to playstation eyetoy back in the day. It supports 1-4 players.
